title: gp asset provenance
description: Written next to every generated image as <stem>.provenance.json. The asset gate treats a missing or incomplete record as a failure, exactly like a broken alpha channel. Rationale: 'one more enemy in the same style, six months from now' is impossible without knowing what produced the first twenty. When an image is produced inside an agent session (Codex Desktop image_gen) rather than by a script, the AGENT writes this record — the obligation does not disappear with the automation.

provider.description: gemini = scripted API call from a Claude session. codex-native = Codex Desktop image_gen, human-in-the-loop. manual = any other tool, file dropped into assets/inbox/.

model.description: Exact model identifier, or 'unknown' with a reason in notes when the provider does not expose one.

parameters.description: Whatever the provider accepted: seed, size, guidance, aspect ratio. Free-form because providers disagree; recorded verbatim.

reference_sheet_sha256.description: Hash of the frozen reference sheet manifest this generation was conditioned on. Changing the sheet after STYLE LOCK invalidates comparability, and this field is how that is detected.

operator.description: Which session produced it: claude-code, codex-desktop, human.

attempt.description: Which try this was. Useful when reading back how expensive a given asset actually was.
